verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly points to built-in object storage. R2 appears by name as a Cloudflare product with API endpoints and bucket-creation events. Workers can connect to 'storage' via Bindings, and Cloudflare Images claims to store and deliver images. None of this documents persisting user uploads from a Worker into an object store. Missing for 10: explicit docs of R2 as object storage bound to Workers, an upload/put API example for user-generated files, coverage of non-image file types, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
